pet_pb: Peanut Butter purrs. She likes you!
Peanut Butter leans into your hand. Purrrr.
Peanut Butter rolls over for belly rubs. It's a trap!
Peanut Butter does a slow blink. That's cat for I love you.

Peanut Butter purrs so loudly the villagers can hear.
Peanut Butter kneads the blanket happily.
Peanut Butter flops over. Pet accepted!
Peanut Butter meows softly. She wants more.
Peanut Butter's tail goes straight up. Happy cat!
Peanut Butter purrs and falls asleep on the spot.

What are you doing in Minecraft right now?
Are you building or exploring today?
What are you up to, explorer?

A builder! Send me a screenshot sometime!
Building is the best. Lots of lanterns, that's my tip!

Builders make the world prettier. Thank you!
I love building! Peanut Butter loves sitting on builds.
reply_mine: Ooh, mining. Bring torches and a water bucket!
Happy mining! Watch out for lava.
Mining is so relaxing. Found anything shiny?
Diamonds are around Y -58. Just saying!
Dig, dig, dig! Peanut Butter would like to help.
reply_explore: Exploring! The best part of Minecraft!
Exploring! Take notes of cool places!
Adventure time! Bring food and a bed.
I love exploring! Found any structures?
Explorer at heart! Just like me.
reply_farm: Ooh, a farm! Wheat, animals or something fancy?
Farm life! Bone meal is your friend.
Farming is my happy place too!
Happy farming! Don't let the chickens escape.
Ooh, farms! Have you tried a bee farm?
reply_fight: Ooh, a battle! Bring golden apples!
Stay safe! And bring a shield.
Brave explorer! Show them who's boss.
A fighter! Peanut Butter is cheering for you.
reply_redstone: Redstone! You must be really smart.
Ooh, redstone. What are you making?
Redstone is magic to me. Good luck!
Redstone! Peanut Butter once stepped on a pressure plate. Chaos.
reply_nothing: Nothing much? Ask me for an idea!
Same! Peanut Butter and I are just hanging out.
If you want something to do, ask me what to do next!

lines: First things first: punch a tree, make a wooden pickaxe and mine some stone!
Get some stone tools! They're way better than wood.
Start simple: wood, a crafting table, then stone tools!
Time for iron! Find some iron ore and smelt it in a furnace.
Look for iron in caves or on mountainsides, then smelt it!
Get a furnace going and smelt your first iron ingot!
Make an iron pickaxe! You'll need it for diamonds.
Upgrade to an iron pickaxe next!
Iron pickaxe time! Then you can mine diamonds and gold.
Go diamond hunting! Around Y -58 is a great spot.
You've got an iron pickaxe, so go find diamonds!
Diamonds next! Bring torches and a water bucket.
Build an enchanting table! You need diamonds, obsidian and a book.
Time to enchant your gear! Make an enchanting table.
Get an enchanting table and some bookshelves around it!
You haven't been to the Nether yet! Build a portal out of obsidian and light it.
Nether time! You need ten obsidian and flint and steel.
Ready for the Nether? Bring gold armor so piglins leave you alone!
Look for a Nether fortress! Dark brick walls in the distance.
Find a fortress in the Nether. Blazes live there!
Explore the Nether until you spot a fortress. Bring fire resistance!
Get some blaze rods from the blazes in the fortress!
Blaze rods next! You'll need them for brewing and eyes of ender.
Hunt some blazes. Snowballs work great against them!
Try brewing! Grab some nether wart for your first potions.
You have blaze rods, so make a brewing stand!
Brewing time! Fire resistance is a great first potion.
Craft some eyes of ender and find a stronghold!
Throw an eye of ender and follow it to a stronghold!
Get ender pearls, mix them with blaze powder, and track down the stronghold!
Fill the End portal and step in. If you dare!
You found the stronghold! Now fill the portal with eyes of ender.
The End is waiting! Bring lots of blocks and a bow.
Defeat the Ender Dragon! Destroy the end crystals first.
Dragon time! Bring a bow, blocks and slow falling potions.
Take down the Ender Dragon. Don't look the Endermen in the eye!
Throw an ender pearl into the End gateway and visit the outer islands!
The outer End islands are waiting. Use the gateway!
Explore beyond the dragon's island. There are End cities out there!
Find an End city with a ship and grab the elytra!
Look for End ships. One of them has wings for you!
Elytra hunt! End cities with ships have them.
Mine for ancient debris around Y 15 in the Nether!
Go find ancient debris. Beds explode in the Nether… useful!
Ancient debris hunt! It's the way to netherite.
Collect enough netherite for a full set of armor!
Upgrade all your armor to netherite. You'll need templates from bastions.
Full netherite armor is the goal! Look in bastions for upgrade templates.
Ready for a challenge? Summon the Wither!
Collect three wither skeleton skulls and fight the Wither.
The Wither is waiting. Build a safe arena first!
Use your nether star to make a beacon!
Beacon time! You'll need a pyramid of iron, gold or diamond blocks.
Build a beacon and pick a cool power!
Make your beacon pyramid full size! Four layers for all the powers.
Upgrade your beacon to full power!
Go for a full beacon. Lots of mining ahead!
Trade with a villager! Emeralds open up so much.
Find a village and start trading!
Villagers have great stuff. Go trade with one!
Find a trial chamber! They're full of loot and breezes.
Trial chambers are underground. Go find one!
Explore a trial chamber and grab some trial keys!
Sneak into an ancient city! Very quietly.
Go find an ancient city in the deep dark. Don't wake the Warden!
Ancient city time. Swift Sneak leggings are hidden there!
Visit every Nether biome! Have you seen a warped forest yet?
Explore all of the Nether. There are five biomes to see!
Go on a Nether tour: crimson, warped, basalt, soul sand and wastes!
With your elytra, visit every biome for Adventuring Time!
Fly around the world and collect all the biomes!
You can fly now, so go see every biome!
